title: Chapter 664
paragraphs: Chapter 664
Episode 169: To the Sanctuary of the Nemesis (2)
"Zephyr's sanctuary......?"
He had never heard of such a thing. Not in his past life, nor in this one.
[Yes, Zephyr's sanctuary. Full Magic Bodies that are almost completely open are practically immortal as long as they can use that space. Just being in the sanctuary can heal all wounds.]
"I've never heard of such a place, let alone that Full Magic Bodies can regenerate so miraculously there."
[Is that a lie, cough, you say?]
"For now, yes."

[Believe it or not, that's up to you, Jin Runkandel. But if that's not the case, the only other way is to get the tears of Numereus. Let me warn you, we don't have Numereus's tears. You can check it through Yuria.]
"I said for now. If you explain in more detail, I might start to trust you."
[I've gone to the trouble of bringing my sick body to you to tell you the way, and from the start, I'm being treated as a liar. Why should I do that?]
At that, Jin snorted.
"Hey, Orgal. Do we really need to exchange pointless words among those who know? There's no way you came to see me in such a beaten up state just for the Barmel Union."
Jin, throwing Orgal's bloody handkerchief in the trash can.
"You must have come in such a hurry because it would be a problem if Hister dies too. King of Magic Beasts, Orgal, you definitely need Hister's power to restore your manipulated history. Am I wrong?"
Orgal shrugged his shoulders.
[I didn't expect such a reaction to just a guess. Yes, you're right. Aside from my history, Hister's abilities are absolutely necessary to counter the calamity from the beginning.]
"Then let's put the idle talk aside and continue the conversation."
Swooosh-!
Suddenly a small iron door appeared in the middle of the hospital room.
Unlike usual, the door, which used to teleport the user and the target, was revealing a green landscape.
"A sea shining in green......? It also looks like a desert."
[You could see it that way.]
"Is that the scenery you said is Zephyr's sanctuary?"
[Yes, it's not its current state. I'm sharing my memory with you. It's from a few hundred years ago, but it probably hasn't changed.]
"I think this is the first time I've seen magic of that color."
[It's not magic. It's a force without a specific name, I call it residual energy.]
"Residual energy? Do you mean the power left by the being beyond the gods you mentioned before."]
Orgal nodded his head.
"What does that have to do with Full Magic Bodies?"

[Full Magic Bodies are the only humans that show a reaction to residual energy. Any disease, wound, or scar. Physical damage of any kind, the residual energy seeps in and completely heals it. But this is only possible if the Full Magic Body is opened to a certain level.]
"Is there a specific reason why only Full Magic Bodies respond to residual energy?"

[Well, I can't know the reason. I'm just guessing that it's because some will of that existence is nestled among the owners of Full Magic Bodies. Perhaps Full Magic Bodies are blessings only allowed to those who have been permeated by that will.]
According to his explanation, 'residual energy' could heal all wounds, except for aging and psychological shocks, but only for the owners of Full Magic Bodies.
Then, a vague human figure appeared in the landscape inside the iron door.
Although it was not clear, it was easy to recognize that it was missing an arm.
[That memory is fuzzy, so it's not shared properly. It's probably a Full Magic Body like Hister.]
The figure in the scene lay down in the middle of the sanctuary.
'Insane......'
After a while, Jin could see the figure's severed arm starting to grow anew.
The residual energy of the sanctuary and the figure's magic mixed together, creating a colorful light and bubbles.
[You have a thoughtful look on your face. Do you think I'm showing you this scene as a false manipulation?]
Of course, Jin thought it was not entirely impossible.
Given the powers Orgal has shown so far, it seemed entirely possible.
But Jin decided to trust Orgal. If it were true, there would be no better way.
Orgal had no particular reason to lie at this point.
Yet, the reason Jin paused was because another thought came to mind.

"In my opinion, not only Full Magic Bodies, but you too, could probably recover if you went there. And you don't know the current location of Zephyr's sanctuary. So you're hoping that I'll find out the location of the sanctuary, using this occasion of saving Hister as an excuse. Am I wrong?"
A faint smile appeared at the corner of Orgal's mouth.
[Sometimes, we seem to communicate very well. You're right, cough.]

"Do you trust me too much because we communicate well? Even if I find out the location, I have no intention of sharing it with you, Orgal. You regaining all your power would be no different to me and the people of the world than another calamity awakening."
[I'm hurt you think so poorly of me. Anyway, as long as you find out the location, we can make a deal someday when your perception of me changes or when I have something you can't refuse.]
"That's quite a dubious future."
[Zephyr would never trade with me for the location of the sanctuary, no matter what happens. Originally, it would be the same for you.]
"Is it that we have no choice but to accept the deal this time, because Hister's life is on the line?"
[Yes. At this moment, probably Zipel wants to save Hister more than you do. How about it, isn't it an enticing story?]
"It would be very tempting if all of it is true. But, I don't think Zipel will reveal the sanctuary willingly."

[Threats, persuasion, extortion, you're more professional than I am. Besides, you're holding Hister, one of Zipel's biggest weaknesses, so I think you can negotiate favorable conditions by yourself. Well, let me help you more.]
Jin met Orugal's gaze.
[The multicolored foam and bubbles that occur when the residual energy reacts with a complete magic body owner. You can trade with that.]
"It seems Zipel can conduct some kind of research with that."
[Indeed, you understand quickly. Yes, even that would be a substantial reward for Zipel. Of course, he'll demand more than that. Kehuk! He would regret missing it if you refuse.]
Jin took out a new handkerchief from the drawer and wiped his blood.
"Although you're sharing this information because you want something, I will at least say thank you."
[Keuhuk, yes, you seem, keuk, thankful.]
Afterward, the two talked about how to deal with Zipel's arrival for a while.
Near the end of the conversation, Jet found the sickroom.
"My lord! Someone from Zipel is coming. The spaceship Kojek has entered the country."
"Got it, Jet. I'll go out soon."
"Yes, sir!"
The brains from Zipel who visited Tikan were Octavia, Ronil, and Kadun. Hedo and Sandra were not seen.
Kadun was in his human form, and his body was bandaged. He hadn't fully recovered from the injuries he got during the attack on the Garden of Sword.

It was not an easy wound to heal. He took the most direct hit from the spirit of Rosa and Ram, and he was seriously injured again in the Calduran plain, so it was almost a miracle that he could even move now.
Jin faced them with a stoic expression, but he secretly rejoiced at Kadun's condition.
'It seems like he is in desperate need of a chaos purifier.'
Unlike Jin, Kadun had been openly showing his anger since he entered the Tikan Palace.
"Have you arrived?"
Kasimir greeted them personally with his colleagues.

"Have we arrived? Yes, we have! You sons of bitches, just a few days ago we formed an alliance. You left us out in the Calduran plain and ran off? Even though it was temporary, didn't you think that it was too thuggish?"
"You seem quite angry, Kadun."
Upon hearing Jin's voice, Kadun's eyes nearly popped out. His bandages were aflame, revealing his wounds.
"The 12th trainee...!"
"But, isn't it fair to call it tit for tat?"
"What?"

"On the day when the power Rosa had been hiding was revealed, why did you and Kinzelo launch a total offensive on Runkandel? Let's guess. Because you were sure that I would definitely fight against the entire Garden of Sword. So you saw an opportunity to annihilate me and the Garden of Sword."
"Ha, back then we were not temporarily allied with you. We were enemies, do you think we were on the same side?"

"I admit it, so I forgave that thuggish behavior and accepted you as an ally. But now you come here and throw a tantrum without even asking about the situation, it's not very pleasant to see. It seems like you think we deliberately abandoned you, but look there."
"What exactly are you asking me to look at...."
Following Jin's finger, Kadun looked at the entrance of the Tikan Palace and was at a loss for words. There was Orugal, who was being supported by Zephyrin and was constantly coughing up blood.
[Ah... you... arrived... Kadun, keuk...keuk!]

"We were able to escape through Orugal's steel gate at that time. How could we escape to Zipel with him in that state? Moreover, Runkandel, the former tenth knight you faced, was being summoned right in front of us."
[Sorry...Keuk, forget it. Kadun...]
"The situation was really urgent at that time. If you want, you can check with the contractor of Az's mill here."
Kadun had no more words to say as he watched Orugal fall and be lifted up repeatedly by Kinzelo members.
Of course, Kadun was not a fool and expected that the situation must have been urgent, but he had no idea that Orugal would be in such a state.
"In addition, while Zipel did suffer damage, no important figures died, and the temporary allies achieved their goals. We rescued Hister, and I was reincarnated. Isn't this not a bad outcome?"
As Kadun was about to say something, Ronil stepped forward and slightly bowed his head.
"We agree with that. Just, there were some emotional elements, so please understand why Kadun was angry."
"I will do so."
"How is Hister's condition? We have been nagged by Kinzelo, but we don't know the details."
"He's barely alive. Orugal said that he should be able to recover if he goes to your sanctuary."
Ronil blinked his eyes for a few seconds. As if asking how did you know that.
"......What did you just say?"
